description: A pair of eyeglasses sits on the surface next to an open white glasses pouch, with a pillow in the background. The left hand slides toward the pouch and steadies it while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the glasses, lifts them, then brings them over and lowers them into the open pouch as the left hand supports and folds the pouch closed around them, briefly making the pouch a two-hand object.
